label: Every CONCRETE_6 individual that exists at w and is contingent at w…, by Universal… (3)
rule: Universal instantiation, existential elimination and introduction
meaning: An actual contingent concretum has esse by participation, so a distinct cause of its esse (q.44 a.1 co. reading), which by the esse-cause bridge is an actual concrete ground. The ground is distinct, which is more than the target requires.
